text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, once we get back to the academy,
let's start preparing for the next race.
choice_data_list: Before that, congratulations on your victory!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...There is no need to swing between joy and sorrow.
More importantly, we must push further ahead than before.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I run... and I win.
That is all.
choice_data_list: Even so, please accept my wish to celebrate you.
You're right, we can't let our guard down!

We have a mountain of things to do to prepare for what's next.
